id.instruksi: Semua pot disiram. Lihat tempat tiap pot dan dengarkan namanya. Pilih pot yang kekurangan cahaya sehingga tanamannya sulit tumbuh sehat.
id.t-r1: Satu pot ditaruh di jendela, satu di lemari gelap. Pot mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r2: Pot di jendela, pot di teras, dan pot di kotak tertutup. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r3: Semua disiram, tapi satu tak kena cahaya. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r4: Mana pot yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat karena gelap?
id.t-r5: Satu pot di kebun, satu di gudang gelap. Pot mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r6: Pot di teras, pot di jendela, dan pot di kolong tempat tidur. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r7: Mana pot yang tidak kena sinar matahari, sehingga sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r8: Tiga pot disiram setiap hari. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r9: Mana pot yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat karena tidak mendapat cahaya?
id.t-r10: Pot di kebun, pot di teras, dan pot di dalam kotak tertutup. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?
id.t-r11: Satu pot di kebun, satu di kolong tempat tidur. Mana yang akan sulit tumbuh sehat?

en.instruksi: Every pot is watered. Look at each location and listen to its name. Choose the pot without enough light for healthy growth.
en.t-r1: One pot is by the window, one in a dark cupboard. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r2: A pot by the window, one on the porch, one in a closed box. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r3: All were watered, but one gets no light. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r4: Which pot will struggle to grow healthily because it is dark?
en.t-r5: One pot is in the garden, one in a dark shed. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r6: A pot on the porch, one by the window, one under the bed. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r7: Which pot gets no sunlight, so it will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r8: Three pots are watered every day. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r9: Which pot will struggle to grow healthily because it gets no light?
en.t-r10: A pot in the garden, one on the porch, one in a closed box. Which will struggle to grow healthily?
en.t-r11: One pot is in the garden, one under the bed. Which will struggle to grow healthily?

itemCount.keterangan: jumlah pot per tebakan: 2 → 4; latar pot menunjukkan terang/gelap
